_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Vanilla Minecraft egg in pelican-eggs/minecraft (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Vanilla
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The official Minecraft Java server from Mojang. Any release or snapshot, checked against Mojang's checksums, with tuned Java settings.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Vanilla. Downloads Mojang's server jar for the chosen version
# and checks it against Mojang's SHA-1. Worlds and settings are never
# touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new one checks out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

manifest=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json) ||
    fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
version="${VANILLA_VERSION:-latest}"
case "$version" in
    "" | latest) version=$(jq -r '.latest.release' <<<"$manifest") ;;
    snapshot) version=$(jq -r '.latest.snapshot' <<<"$manifest") ;;
esac
meta_url=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' <<<"$manifest")
[ -n "$meta_url" ] ||
    fail "Minecraft has no version $version. Set Version to latest, snapshot, or a version such as $(jq -r '.latest.release' <<<"$manifest")."
meta=$(get "$meta_url") || fail "Mojang can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
url=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.url // empty' <<<"$meta")
[ -n "$url" ] || fail "Minecraft $version has no server download from Mojang. Choose a newer version."
sum=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.sha1' <<<"$meta")
java=$(jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' <<<"$meta")

if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha1sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Minecraft $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Minecraft $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$url"
    [ "$(sha1sum "$jar.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download didn't match Mojang's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
fi
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed Minecraft $version. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.4, latest for the newest release, or snapshot for the newest snapshot. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.
